name: List All Unit Attachments
description: Returns all attachments associated with a unit

queryFilters.name: filters[UnitId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unit ID. All GET requests must include a filter for [UnitId] or [CreatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[CreatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter by creation date from. All GET requests must include a filter for [UnitId] or [CreatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name given to describe the attachment

responseFields.name: data[].ContentType
responseFields.description: The content type of the unit attachment. An example content type is a photo or a PDF.

responseFields.name: data[].CreatedAt
responseFields.description: The date and time the unit attachment was created by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the attachment

responseFields.name: data[].URL
responseFields.description: The link to download the file in the attachment

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
